description: This file defines the PlaywrightConnection class, managing WebSocket-like communication, connection lifecycle, and resource cleanup for Playwright's remote protocol.

classes.name: PlaywrightConnection
classes.description: Manages remote Playwright protocol connections, message dispatching, and cleanup.

methods.name: _onDisconnect
methods.description: Handles cleanup and resource release when the connection is disconnected.

methods.name: logServerMetadata
methods.description: Logs metadata about messages sent and received for debugging.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection, optionally with a reason.
